results.summary: Customer is locked out of their account after three failed password reset attempts, as the reset email is never received, and needs access to complete time-sensitive work today.
Customer reports production dashboard has been unavailable since 9:05 AM, with multiple users receiving 503 errors and operations team unable to monitor jobs.
Customer was charged twice for the same monthly subscription and is requesting a review and refund of the duplicate charge.
Customer requests a CSV export option for filtered results on the reports page to avoid manual data copying.
Customer reports that loading the customer list takes ~40 seconds since the latest update, up from under 5 seconds, slowing down their team's daily work.
A new employee is unable to access the team workspace and receives an "Access denied" message despite the sender confirming the invitation email address is correct.
Customer received a login alert from an unrecognized country and wants support to check if anything was accessed or changed in their account.
All customers are unable to complete checkout since 10:40 due to HTTP 500 errors returned by the payment API, causing ongoing loss of sales.
Customer cancelled their subscription last week and is requesting a refund for the unused days remaining in the current month, with no time pressure indicated.
The /sync API endpoint is timing out after 60+ seconds, causing the customer's nightly import to fail for two consecutive nights with no workaround, leaving their team with stale data each day.
